domain: Asset Intelligence V2 — Creative Knowledge Foundation
description: Extends the existing Asset Library with auto-tagging, duplicate detection, perceptual hash abstraction, version chains, similar-asset search, quality metadata, suggested usage, licensing metadata placeholder, asset safety classification, and knowledge taxonomy for 10 creative asset types.

routesToMount.mountComment: Team 06 — Asset Intelligence V2 — mount AFTER global adminAuth middleware; routes include both /ai/asset-intelligence/v2/* (admin) and /public/customer/workspace/:token/asset-intelligence/v2/* (public)

tablesCreated.name: ai_platform.ai_asset_intelligence_v2
tablesCreated.description: Extended intelligence per asset: knowledge taxonomy, quality scoring, duplicate detection, version type

tablesCreated.name: ai_platform.ai_asset_version_chains
tablesCreated.description: Groups all intentional variants of the same logical asset into a chain

tablesCreated.name: ai_platform.ai_asset_licensing
tablesCreated.description: Licensing metadata placeholder (proprietary/CC/RF/AI-generated). licenseOwner and notes are admin-only — redacted in public API.

tablesCreated.name: ai_platform.ai_asset_safety
tablesCreated.description: Brand safety classification: safe|review|unsafe with rule-based flag detection

integrationOrder: 2. Mount router in app.ts AFTER global adminAuth middleware
4. Add sidebar item under Intelligence section
knownRisks: Perceptual hash is metadata-based (filename + size + checksum), not pixel-based. True image similarity requires real pHash (sharp/dhash). The interface is compatible — upgrading to pixel-based is a drop-in replacement.

ai_asset_intelligence_v2 (asset_id, asset_source) UNIQUE constraint may conflict if the same asset was already analyzed by v1 under the same IDs — they use separate tables so no conflict, but clientId isolation depends on correct emailHash being passed by callers.
Version chain auto-grouping uses exact hash match. Cross-device re-uploads with different checksums will NOT be auto-grouped even if visually identical.
Safety classification is rule-based (keyword matching). False positives on words like 'adult' in legitimate contexts (e.g. 'adult education'). Manual override should be added in a follow-up.
Licensing metadata is a placeholder — no automated license detection. Admin must manually set license type via PUT /licensing/:assetId.

areas: knowledge tag inference per asset type
